businessName: ROOFTOPz Botanical Restaurant & Hotel Virasat Retreat
whatsappMessage:
Hi Team ROOFTOPz Botanical Restaurant,

I noticed your heritage boutique stay and rooftop restaurant has great 3.9★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a lightning-fast mobile booking experience for direct room and banquet reservations.

Maine aapke hotel aur rooftop restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp room booking, ROOFTOPz dining menu, aur banquet inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.hotelvirasatretreat.in/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team ROOFTOPz Botanical Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke hotel aur ROOFTOPz restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp room bookings, room tariff plans, and banquet inquiry triggers right opposite Medanta Hospital. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact room photos aur tariff updates integrate karke live kar sakte hain.
